legends: Processes blocked waiting for I/O to complete

metrics.label: Processes blocked waiting for I/O to complete

kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_procs_blocked IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_procs_running IS NOT NULL
| STATS Processes_blocked_waiting_for_I_O_to_complete = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_procs_blocked)), Processes_in_runnable_state = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_procs_running)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.instance`, `labels.job`, Processes_blocked_waiting_for_I_O_to_complete, Processes_in_runnable_state
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_processes_state IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_processes_state = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_processes_state)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.state
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_forks_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_forks_total = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_forks_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| SORT time_bucket ASC

legends: Processes virtual memory size in bytes
Maximum amount of virtual memory available in bytes
Processes virtual memory size in bytes
Maximum amount of virtual memory available in bytes

metrics.label: Processes Virtual Memory Size In Bytes
Maximum Amount Of Virtual Memory Available In Bytes

kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.process_virtual_memory_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.process_resident_memory_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.process_virtual_memory_max_bytes IS NOT NULL
| STATS Processes_virtual_memory_size_in_bytes = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.process_virtual_memory_bytes)), Resident_memory_size_in_bytes = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.process_resident_memory_bytes)), Maximum_amount_of_virtual_memory_available_in_bytes = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.process_virtual_memory_max_bytes)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| EVAL series_group = CONCAT(COALESCE(TO_STRING(`labels.instance`), ""), " / ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(`labels.job`), ""))
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_processes_pids IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_processes_max_processes IS NOT NULL
| STATS Number_of_PIDs = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_processes_pids)), PIDs_limit = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_processes_max_processes)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.instance`, `labels.job`, Number_of_PIDs, PIDs_limit
| SORT time_bucket ASC

legends: CPU {{ cpu }} - seconds spent running a process
CPU {{ cpu }} - seconds spent by processing waiting for this CPU

metrics.label: CPU  - seconds spent running a process
CPU  - seconds spent by processing waiting for this CPU

kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_schedstat_running_seconds_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_schedstat_waiting_seconds_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS CPU_seconds_spent_running_a_process = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_schedstat_running_seconds_total)), node_schedstat_waiting_seconds_total_B = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_schedstat_waiting_seconds_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.cpu
| EVAL CPU_seconds_spent_by_processing_waiting_for_this_CPU = (-1 * node_schedstat_waiting_seconds_total_B)
| DROP node_schedstat_waiting_seconds_total_B
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_processes_threads IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_processes_max_threads IS NOT NULL
| STATS Allocated_threads = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_processes_threads)), Threads_limit = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_processes_max_threads)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.instance`, `labels.job`, Allocated_threads, Threads_limit
| SORT time_bucket ASC
